about: A recorded first-hour conversation, synthetic throughout (#2204). The owner gives one fresh small idea for their own selected repository (the one setup prepared), not the demo; the spec and its tickets come from this grill's answers, never a prepared plan. Steps name skills/onboard/SKILL.md's numbered sections; tool steps run the installed onboarding helper against #1108's recording fakes.

options.label: as reported by CloudRoom; it may answer from a saved copy

turns.agent: You bring an idea. I grill you with a few quick questions, write it up as a spec you confirm, and split it into small tickets you approve as one plan. Each ticket gets a builder agent; a reviewer from another model family reviews each pull request, and approved green work merges. Nothing starts until you approve the plan.
Pick one: a quick fun idea in a new disposable demo repository, or one of your repositories. Setup prepared synthetic-owner/synthetic-consumer; use that?

turns.user: My own repository, synthetic-owner/synthetic-consumer. I want a link checker for its docs.

turns.agent: Q1: Check only relative links between the README and docs/ (recommended), or web links too? Q2: Print each broken link with its file and line (recommended), or only a count? Q3: Exit nonzero when any link is broken, so CI can use it (recommended)?

turns.user: Relative links only, file and line, and yes to the exit code.

turns.agent: Summary: a docs link checker for this repository: it finds Markdown links in README.md and docs/, checks each relative target exists, prints every broken link with its file and line, and exits nonzero when any is broken. Confirm?

Which harness and model (offered: codex syn-codex-model-01; claude-code syn-claude-model-01)? Which effort? Where should the fleet's agents run: Cloud (recommended, uses Cloud Credits) or Local? This is separate from your engine, which runs locally. Each pull request is reviewed by the other model family, so a Codex fleet needs your Claude Code sign-in for its reviewer, and a Claude Code fleet needs your Codex sign-in.

turns.user: Codex, syn-codex-model-01, high, in the Cloud. My Claude Code sign-in is there for the reviewer.

turns.agent: Spec: Docs link checker. Find Markdown links in README.md and docs/, check relative targets exist, print each broken link with file and line, exit nonzero on any. Confirm the spec?

spec.title: Spec: docs link checker
spec.body: Find Markdown links in README.md and docs/, check each relative target exists, print every broken link with its file and line, and exit nonzero when any is broken.

tickets.title: L3: print file and line for each broken link
L4: exit nonzero on a broken link
L5: document the checker in docs/

turns.agent: Plan: five tickets; L1, L2 and L3 can start at once, L4 and L5 after their blockers merge. Approve this plan graph?
